neighbours.label: the closing word of a paired 'X and Y' phrase in factual or statistical prose (women and men, air and ground)
fire: The survey covered roughly equal numbers of girls and boys in each school.
Losses were heavy both at sea and on land during the campaign.
The treaty applies under both national and international law.
Rates of the disease were similar among husbands and wives.
Data were collected from urban and rural households alike.
The virus spreads quickly among adults and children in winter.
Prices rose sharply for both buyers and sellers last quarter.
